description: Delighting on one Spark: Marigold IID Appearance v1.1 (ETH Zurich, prs-eth) decomposes one photo or render into an albedo free of baked lighting plus roughness and metallic, with the creator's diffusers pipeline and defaults. The only setting is the noise seed; steps, processing resolution (768 px) and output resampling are the model's own defaults. Output: albedo.png (sRGB, carries the input's alpha), roughness.png and metallic.png (8-bit grayscale; the predicted values themselves, not the creator's inverted display colouring or display gamma, because a PBR map is the value). The model was trained on indoor InteriorVerse scenes; it is the image-domain partner of CHORD, which handles flat textures. The weights are OpenRAIL++-M; the licence is shown for information and nothing here gates on it. Memory is an estimate from the 2.6 GB of fp16 weights and 768 px processing; the hardware try decides.

seed.description: Noise seed; the same seed and input give the same maps.
